rooky/630a4120.text: Chess players all over the world share a few little words. Let's learn what to say at the table, in English and in Hindi! Priya will say each Hindi word for you.

rooky/b5d1e6ff.text: Fun fact: checkmate and Shah-maat come from the same old Persian words. Shah means king, so Shah-maat means, the king is stuck!
